Reason for Mistake: The Planner misclassified the concept by conflating properties with states. Compressibility and expansion to fill a container are physical properties of matter (of gases), not the categorical “states of matter.” The agent incorrectly restricted “properties of matter” to state-independent traits and prematurely finalized the wrong option (B) instead of the correct (C).
